title: Halting state under the seam construction
statement: Let $c$ be a configuration of an $m$-tape Turing machine on a fixed Boolean input, and suppose its state is absent, which denotes that the machine has halted. Then the state of the configuration obtained by the seam construction is also absent.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a configuration on a fixed Boolean input
